name: clickscope
description: Read-only ClickHouse access for any deployment — self-hosted, clustered or Cloud. Explore schemas, and cost a query with EXPLAIN ESTIMATE before running it so a full scan is caught before it starts. Ships query-craft guidance alongside the MCP server.

CLICKHOUSE_HOST.title: Server
CLICKHOUSE_HOST.description: clickhouse.internal, host:port, or a full URL like https://abc.clickhouse.cloud:8443. Port and HTTPS are taken from what you enter.

CLICKHOUSE_USER.title: Username
CLICKHOUSE_USER.description: Use an account granted only SELECT — the database is the layer that can actually enforce read-only.

CLICKHOUSE_PASSWORD.title: Password
CLICKHOUSE_PASSWORD.description: Stored in your system keychain, never in a settings file. Leave empty for a server with no password.

CLICKHOUSE_DATABASE.title: Database
CLICKHOUSE_DATABASE.description: Used when a tool call does not name one.
